from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import sys,json,hashlib
import numpy as np
import torch
root=Path('controlled_furrowing').resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from sparse_quadratic import AxisymmetricModel,Parameters,SparsePolicy
from quadratic_quadrature_study import AxisymmetricModel as HighModel,IntegrationPolicy,evaluate
from run_joint_refinement import material_curve_difference
torch.set_num_threads(1);program=globals().get('program','Replay code retained in original receipt.')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
result=json.loads((root/'runs/joint_refinement/final.json').read_text())
solve=json.loads((root/'evidence/joint_refinement_solve.json').read_text())
comparison=json.loads((root/'evidence/joint_refinement_comparison.json').read_text())
coarse=json.loads((root/'runs/activated_quadrature/lambda_5000.0_strength_10.0/reequilibrated.json').read_text())
m=AxisymmetricModel(Parameters(**result['parameters']));high=HighModel(Parameters(**result['parameters']))
v=np.array(result['free_displacement']);gain=result['activation_strength'];e,g=m.objective(v,gain);ee,gg=high.objective(v,gain)
q12=AxisymmetricModel(Parameters(**result['parameters']),integration_policy=IntegrationPolicy(12,16));cross=evaluate(q12,result)
checks={'all_locked_sources_match':all(sha(root/'scripts'/n)==s for n,s in solve['protocol']['sources'].items()),
        'fine_field_hash':sha(root/'runs/joint_refinement/final.json')==solve['final_sha256']==comparison['fine_sha256'],
        'coarse_field_hash':sha(root/'runs/activated_quadrature/lambda_5000.0_strength_10.0/reequilibrated.json')==comparison['coarse_sha256'],
        'physical_energy_gradient_bitidentity':e==ee and np.array_equal(g,gg),
        'Q8_stationarity_replay':np.max(abs(g))<1e-7,
        'Q12_stationarity_replay':cross['scaled_force_linf']<1e-7,
        'all_runner_checks_pass':all(solve['checks'].values()),
        'exact_J_and_embedding':solve['geometry']['all_exact_J_positive'] and solve['geometry']['global_embedding_certified'],
        'entire_fine_pattern_row_color_unique':m.pattern_receipt['row_color_collision_free']}
H,meta=m.recover_hessian(v,gain)
rng=np.random.default_rng(119119);hvs=[]
for k in range(3):
    direction=rng.normal(size=len(v));direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
    u=torch.tensor(v,dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
    E=m.energy_components(m.coordinates(u),gain)['total']/m.energy_scale
    gradient=torch.autograd.grad(E,u,create_graph=True)[0]
    direct=torch.autograd.grad(gradient,u,grad_outputs=torch.tensor(direction,dtype=torch.float64))[0].detach().numpy()
    recovered=H@direction;err=float(np.max(abs(recovered-direct)))/max(1.,float(np.max(abs(direct))))
    checks[f'actual_16x8_Hv_AD_{k}']=err<1e-11;hvs.append(err)
def rational(d):return Q(d['numerator'],d['denominator'])
for side in ('top','bottom'):
    c=comparison['comparison'][side+'_Eulerian_vertical'];interval=c['supremum_absolute_discrete_height_difference_um']
    lo=rational(interval['lower']);hi=rational(interval['upper'])
    checks[side+'_rational_interval_order']=0<=lo<=hi
    checks[side+'_requested_reporting_width_met']=c['requested_width_achieved'] and hi-lo<=Q('0.01')
    if side=='top':checks['apical_discrete_discrepancy_exceeds_0p7um']=lo>Q('0.7')
    oldcurve=comparison['comparison'][side+'_material_curve'];fresh=material_curve_difference(result,coarse,side)
    checks[side+'_exact_material_bound_replay']=oldcurve['squared_same_parameter_displacement_lower_exact']==fresh['squared_same_parameter_displacement_lower_exact'] and oldcurve['squared_same_parameter_displacement_upper_exact']==fresh['squared_same_parameter_displacement_upper_exact']
checks={k:bool(v) for k,v in checks.items()}
out={'status':'PASS_INDEPENDENT_JOINT_REPLAY' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL','checks':checks,
     'actual_fine_Hessian_pattern':m.pattern_receipt,'actual_fine_Hv_relative_errors':hvs,'raw_recovery_asymmetry':meta['raw_asymmetry_linf'],
     'force_Q8_replayed':float(np.max(abs(g))),'force_Q12_replayed':cross['scaled_force_linf'],
     'exact_J_lower':solve['geometry']['J_lower_exact'],'exact_J_upper':solve['geometry']['J_upper_exact'],
     'source_hashes':solve['protocol']['sources'],'verification_program':program,
     'input_receipt_hashes':{p:sha(root/'evidence'/p) for p in ('joint_refinement_protocol.json','joint_refinement_solve.json','joint_refinement_comparison.json','joint_refinement_sparse_review.json')},
     'scope':'Independent saved-state replay and actual-size sparseHessian-vector verification; no new solve, data fitting or continuum-error certificate.'}
(root/'evidence/joint_refinement_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':out['status'],'checks':len(checks),'all_pass':all(checks.values()),'Hvs':hvs,'forces':[out['force_Q8_replayed'],out['force_Q12_replayed']],'Jbounds':[float(Q(out['exact_J_lower'])),float(Q(out['exact_J_upper']))]},indent=2))
assert all(checks.values())
